title: Björk · Bachelorette
description: An opera house built from folded pages surrounds the singer with carved paper balconies, ink-black trees and a red proscenium.

performance.lyrics: One day I found a big book buried deep in the ground. I opened it but all the pages were blank and to my surprise, it started writing itself. One day I found a big book very deep in the world. All the fountain of love In the shape of a rock girl Sure, the bird on the ribbon Hypnotized by the well Ah drink it, make me puree you Watch your vegan past dream Jame will play in his life Ah Love's a 283 Ah Give me now, return to you Time will show you soon Is it forget my night, Ah you will go astray Like a killer whale, trapped in a cage I'm a bomb of symptoms burn it under your feet You're the one who walks me I'm your one -way street Ah I look whisper in the water, secret time to hear You're the one who grows this time When I back and root, yeah We are now a child to lose time to show you through the air If you forget my name You will go astray Like a killer wave Ah Ah Ah Ah I'm a tree that grows her heart When furries that you tame You're the intruder's heaven I am the crunch that you break Hold on You shine till I turn the deep Hold on Ah I'll sun do have to end You shall tell everybody it's through Ah And you, you shall dance and do Ah
